title: Eligibility Category Additions to Prior Authorization Extension Requests
content:
The units a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension request asks for carry a population addition that follows the eligibility category of the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership.

| Eligibility category on the Medicaid Managed Care Membership | Units added to the units the extension request asks for |
|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 4 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 4 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 2 |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 2 |
| any other eligibility category | 0 |

The addition applies to the units asked for on an extension request — the figure the member states when filing it — and is made once, before the floor of zero is applied.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- A member in Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids: 4 units are added to the units the extension request asks for.
- A member in Prairie Ridge Dual Complete: 2 units are added.
- A member whose membership is in an eligibility category not named in the table: nothing is added.
